contracts.browser: BrowserSession.connect(endpoint); connect_default(profile_dir=None,consent=False); launch(headless=False,executable_path=None); tabs; new_tab; observe; act; close. Attach never kills user browser or preexisting tabs.
contracts.observation: Opaque revision id, tab_id,url,title,text,elements,truncated,timestamp; optional screenshot base64 PNG. Elements: id,role,name,value,operations,bounds,frame info.
contracts.action: observation_id,operation,target optional,text/value/key/x/y/delta optional. Validate revision, tab, compatibility, coverage before execution; no model selectors or JS.
contracts.provider: DecisionProvider.from_env(provider='openrouter',model=None); choose(observation,goal,history); field_text(observation,goal,target,history); verify(observation,goal,history); close. Typed errors, refusal stops, transport-specific schemas.
contracts.agent: BrowserAgent(session,provider,max_steps=50,...).run(tab_id,goal); status,steps,observation,verification,metrics. DONE requires independent verify; bounded retries/history and consequential-action approval callback.
contracts.extensions: Browser text_continuation(tab_id,observation_id,offset,max_text), owned-only close_tab; upload/download interfaces coordinated by Browser and Integration. OMP integration uses installed public API when available.
